survey_reference.provider: Google satellite tiles, GGL mt1 lyrs=s; exact source tile URLs and digests beside this file. Acquisition date not verified. Public geometric readings only.
survey_reference.uncertainty: About 3–6 native pixels on exposed eaves; change of roofing/connector can affect front length by metres. Ground position of these roof edges is subject to aerial parallax.

observations: The long northwest-to-southeast roof edge faces a distinct open paved courtyard with a central circular planting. In the high-resolution overhead view there are multiple changes of plane along this edge and a strong central break; the southern crosswing shows a broad continuous slope.

Do not treat the three dark changes in the low roof band as an identification of three current dormer windows. The overhead images do not resolve their glazed fronts. The division between the service-wing front and its short connecting roof is not uniquely visible.
The short 15 m line above truncates the longer observable edge near a change of roof colour. It is a test of the 14.8 m architectural estimate, not a measured rigid registration of the 1937 front.

The crosswing is visible in three dates, roughly 16 m on its long projection. The high-resolution southern roof plane has a single prominent outward interruption. Courtyard relationship and repeated dormer pattern remain unconfirmed.

The pale-red eastern roof remains distinct in all three dates. Its present broad slope lacks an independently readable repeated-dormer set. Matching its size alone does not identify it as the photographed service front.

interpretation: The southwest-facing side of the north compound is the first candidate for study. Its entire eave with adjoining pieces is longer than the estimated service facade. A shorter front of about 15 m fits, but this alone is not sufficient to publish a precise geodetic registration or to remove any part of source 798. Keep the reconstruction in local coordinates; assess publication as an approximate site marker or independent study until matching fixed chimney, dormer or original site-plan controls are found.
